view.title: C1 — Context view: the system in its world
view.caption: Who and what does the system touch? The whole conversion-and-certification pipeline, its four actor classes, and its external dependencies. The single system box drawn here is opened in C2a.

nodes.label: QA engineer
detail: IDE + 2 CLIs. In P1 the conversion reasoning happens in THIS actor's IDE (Copilot, ADR 0001); the system receives only committed artifacts

nodes.label: Auditor
detail: Must reconstruct verdicts from stored evidence alone, without access to the running system (ADR 0008)

nodes.label: Mobile Test Automation LLM Pipeline
detail: ACCEPTED: Spring Boot modular monolith, ONE architecture quantum (ADR 0005). Runs inside the bank's validated internal network (E3). Opened in C2a

nodes.label: Perfecto device lab
detail: INCUMBENT vendor — MSA on file, unread against this system's needs (E1). Flows run on mock/synthetic data (E2); artifacts produced OFF-PREM. NOT covered by E3. SLA: UNKNOWN (pending — probe = read the MSA, M1)

nodes.label: Orchestrator AI gateway
detail: Internal gateway; model providers hosted INSIDE the bank — prompts never leave (E4). Version-report contract UNVERIFIED (M5 probe held). SLA: UNKNOWN (pending — M4 consolidated inquiry)

nodes.label: ALM Octane
detail: At BOTH ends of the pipeline (E5): ingest source (REST, API-key) AND certified-asset publish target. Asset-versioning capability UNVERIFIED (M7 probe held). SLA: UNKNOWN (pending)

nodes.label: Excel / ALM-QC
detail: Excel workbooks + ALM-QC later (additive — C1). File input originating from bank teams inside the network (E3/S9). "The least deterministic input" — M16 real-workbook corpus is the probe

edges.label: reviews (hours-days)
edges.detail: Review of ambiguous / sub-threshold cases; async, hours–days

edges.label: versioned export
edges.detail: Read-only versioned export — no access to the running system (ADR 0008); the export is itself an attributable lineage event (CF11)

edges.label: device runs
edges.detail: Device runs on pinned pools (sync); single-run session tokens (ADR 0013)

edges.label: model calls (P2)
edges.detail: Model calls via the Invoke Models seam, P2 (sync)

edges.label: A3: publish
edges.detail: Publish certified assets — async, retryable, idempotent projection, never a verdict precondition (CF3; weeks 3–8)
